The problem

The truth is in the file. Getting it out is the work.

Teams work too hard for too little. Skilled people spend their days rereading documents, reconciling figures and assembling a record for someone else to decide. The predictable part of that work can be automated. The rest still needs a person, and that person needs evidence.

Reading to find what matters

Fields, line items and references are buried in documents, often across many pages and formats.

Checking against rules that live elsewhere

The document is only half the question. Agreed tariffs, policies and references have to sit beside it or the check is guesswork.

Deciding without a clear record

When a finding is handed on, the source, the rule and the review action should travel with it.

What changes

Automate the predictable. Keep people on the rest, with evidence.

01

Extract

Read every field from the source. Flag what looks altered, then map each value with its confidence.

02

Analyze

Every field, cross-checked against the purchase order and delivery note. Material differences rise to the surface.

03

Control

Your team makes the call. Status updates, the count moves, and the next step is ready to forward.

In production

Insurance

Claims, policies and underwriting files.

A claim, a policy and an underwriting file have to agree before anyone can decide.

Example checks

  • Check billed items against the policy, tariff or underwriting file.
  • Match claim figures to the source bill or form.
  • Surface duplicate or inconsistent items for review.

Health insurance claims is the live, in production case.

See the insurance pageSee the health insurance claims case

Healthcare providers

Medical records, bills and claim submissions.

A claim can stall when the medical record, the bill and the submission do not tell the same story.

Example checks

  • Match billed items to the medical record.
  • Check a claim submission against the supporting bill.
  • Flag missing or inconsistent documents for review.
See the healthcare providers page

Banking and lending

Loan applications, bank statements and KYC documents.

A lending file only holds together if the application, the statements and the KYC documents agree.

Example checks

  • Check statement figures against the application.
  • Match identity details across KYC documents.
  • Surface inconsistencies in the supporting pack for review.
See the banking and lending page

Logistics and trade

Invoices, packing lists, bills of lading and customs documents.

A shipment is split across invoices, packing lists, bills of lading and customs documents that have to line up.

Example checks

  • Match invoice totals to packing lists.
  • Check quantities against the bill of lading.
  • Compare invoice and customs figures for review.
See the logistics and trade page

Manufacturing

Purchase orders, delivery notes, supplier invoices and quality certificates.

A supplier invoice should be paid only when it agrees with the purchase order, the delivery note and the quality certificate.

Example checks

  • Match invoice totals to purchase orders.
  • Check delivery notes against the order.
  • Compare supplier invoices with quality certificates for review.

Trust and security

People make the final call.

The platform prepares the record and surfaces what needs attention. Qualified reviewers inspect the evidence and remain responsible for the decision.

GDPR

Integration and deployment

From document to your systems.

Documents can reach enterlabs from email, uploads, scans or system exports. The platform structures and checks them, then returns clean data through APIs and field mappings agreed around the systems you already use.

How processing is deployed

Processing, storage, retention and access are scoped with your security team.

Document processing and personal data redaction can run in your environment before redacted data reaches the managed cloud.
